(215)༄/ /theg pa chen po blo sbyong don bdun ma'i nyams su len tshul snying por dril ba phan bde'i sa bon ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: (215)༄// theg pa chen po blo sbyong don bdun ma'i nyams su len tshul snying por dril ba phan bde'i sa bon ces bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ (216)༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ mkha' khyab 'gro la phan bde'i mchog sbyin pa'i// rin cen byang chub sems dang de ston pa// theg chen dge ba'i bshes la gus btud nas// rgyal sras lam gyi sa bon cung zad dbye// de la theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i man ngag zab mo nyams su len tshul gyi phyag bzhes mdo tsam brjod na gnyis/ thun gyi ngo bo la ji ltar bya ba'i tshul dang*/ thun mtshams su ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo// dang po la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la drug /gnas khang byi dor byas la sku gsung thugs kyi rten dgram pa/ mchod pa g.yo med cing bkod pas mdzes par bshams/ stan bde ba la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis 'khod nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyud la 'dres nges su bya ba/ tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa/ bsags sbyong gi gnad bsdus pa'i yan lag bdun pas rgyud sbyang ba/ dmigs pa gsal bar byas shing maṇḍal phul te don chen po gsum gyis gsol ba gdab pa'o// dang po ni/ bla ma gser gling pa'i rnam thar ltar phyag bzhes su 'debs pa yin pas dgon sde'am ri khrod lta bu gang yin kyang 'dra ste/ rang dbang ba'i gnas khang spyi dang*/ khyad par gang du sdod pa'i khul der/ bdag gis gnas khang (217)'dir 'dug nas gzhung dang bla ma'i man ngag la brten te las su bya ba gzhan spangs la/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub zhig ci nas kyang thob bar bya/ de'i ched du bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa tshogs zhing du bzhugs pa'i gnas 'dir phyag dar bgyi'o snyam du 'phen pa btang la/ rang rgyud kyi sdig sgrib sbyong ba dang*/ rang gzhan gyi sems dang bar 'gyur ba sogs kyi dgos pa dang phan yon dran bzhin pas mi 'dod pa'i khral chos su ma song bar dga' ba dang gus pa'i spyod lam gyis/ thog mar rdul mi ldang ba'i phyir chu gtsang mas bran pa'am/ bsang shing gi dri zhim po sbyar/

rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib nyal nyil rnams phyag bar mos la byi dor legs par byas rjes/ 'byor na dri bzang po'i chus chag chag gdab/ de nas gung du seng ge'i khri sogs bkod pas mdzes par rten gyi gtso bo ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i sku dang*/ de'i steng du chos 'di gtso bor gyur ba'i bla ma brgyud pa/ g.yas g.yon du yi dam gyi lha dang sangs rgyas byang sems/ 'og tu mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha sogs go rim ma log par bsham pa'i mdun nam g.yas g.yon gang bder sher phyin sogs dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam dang*/ mchod rten rnams bzhugs su gsol/ de lta bu'i rten (218)gsum rgyas par ma 'byor yang rang la gang yod pa'i rten rnams bkur bsti dang bcas te dang ba 'dren bar bsham mo// gnyis pa ni/ rang gi gnas der mchod pa dngos su bsham dgos te/ mchod pa med pa dad pa med pa'i rtags yin/ dad pa med pa ni dam pa'i chos rnal ma mi 'byung ba'i rtags yang dag yin pas rang dbang ba'i yo byad sum gcig ma mthar byas pa mchod pa'i phyogs su btang dgos pas/ gong du bshams pa'i rten gsum gyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i snod rab gser dngul/ 'bring li dang 'khar ba/ tha ma'ang rdza shing sogs gang 'byor ba byi dor legs par byas te mchod yon dang*/ me tog dang*/ spos dang*/ mar me sogs dngos gtsang zhing ya yo 'khyar 'khyor du ma song bar bkod pa ci mdzes su bstar/ de yang tshe 'di'i khe grags sogs chos brgyad sgrub pa'i bsam pas ma yin par/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bla ma dang dkon mchog la mchod pa rgya chen po 'bul bar bgyi'o snyam du byang chub kyi sems gsal btab cing mchod pa'i phan yon la spro zhing dad pa shugs drag tu bskyed pa sogs g.yo sgyu'i spyod pa dang bral ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs te/

sbyor ba ser sna dang*/ chog shes dang*/ brnyas bcos sogs ring du dor nas gtsang sbra thon par byas la dga' zhing gus pas lag tu blang ngo*// gsum pa ni/ rgyun bsrings te nyams su len na gnas khang gi phyogs bzhi'am sgo rtsar tho brtan po btsugs la mi'i rgyu 'grul dang phyi nang gi rnam g.yeng sogs spros pa gzhan thams cad rbad kyis bcad/ sdod tshugs pa'i rten 'brel gyi ched rang gi mal 'og tu sa dkar gyi g.yung drung ris chos bskor du bris pa'i steng rtsā ku sha'i chun po dgram pa'ang (219)phyag len du mdzad/ gang ltar yang bsam gtan gyi 'bol chung dngos su bcos pa yod na de dang*/ med na rgyab cung zad mtho zhing 'jam pa'i stan ci ltar rigs pa bsham/ de nas gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po 'dzom pa'i phyi dro'i thun lta bu la mgo bzung ste gong du bshams pa'i stan la lus gnad skyil krung ngam skyil krung byed pas kyang rung ste drang por bsrang*/ ngag gnad rlung phyi nang du rang bzhin gyis rgyu ba de nyer gcig gi bar du ma 'khrul bar bgrang ba la yid gtad de rlung cham la phab/ khyad par sems kyi gnad mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi dbang du ma song bar nges 'byung dang byang chub kyi sems sgo du ma nas yid la bya ste/ 'di ltar blo kha nang du log ste rang gi sems chags sogs nyon mongs kyi dbang du song 'dug gam/ dad pa la sogs pa'i dge sems gang 'dug snyam du brtag par bya/ de ltar brtag pa na rang re las dang po ba rnams la ni sems nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang gis tshe 'di'i snang shas 'ba' zhig 'char ba kho na shas che bas na/ chags sogs nyon mongs pa'i dbang du song 'dug na de ngos zin par byas te/ blo ngan 'di lta bu zhig gis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du bdag rang dbang med par 'khor bar 'khyams shing sdug bsngal bar ma chad par myong du bcug pa yin pas/ da ni blo ngan 'di'i dbang du skad cig kyang mi btang*/

phyin chad nam du'ang rgyud la mi skye ba zhig bya'o snyam du 'dun pa dang snying stobs shugs drag tu bskyed de/ ga re 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du sdug bsngal bar ma chad du myong 'dug kyang skyo ba dang sun pa skad cig kyang med par 'khor ba'i gnas 'ba' zhig la mngon par dga' ba 'di'i dbang du song na/ da dung sngar ltar mtha' med mu med du sdug bsngal kho na zhig myong dgos par (220)'dug /des na da res bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rjes dal ba'i rten bzang po thob/ lam ma nor bar ston pa'i bshes gnyen dam pas rjes su bzung*/ mjal bar dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che yongs su rdzogs pa dang mjal/ blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi mthu cung zad rnyed/ rang gi ngos nas nyams su len nus na myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang nyid kyang bde blag tu ster nus pa'i gdams pa zab mo 'di 'dra thob/ de lta bu'i chos zab mo nyams su len par byed pa la rang dbang yod pa'i skabs 'dir 'bad nas btsan sa zin pa zhig ma byas na/ slar rten bzang 'di 'dra shin tu rnyed par dka'/ lan gcig rnyed pa 'di yang yun ring du mi gnas par myur du 'jig ste nges par 'chi/ nam 'chi la nges pa med/ 'chi ba'i tshe chos ma gtogs gang gis kyang mi phan/ shi nas cang med du mi 'gro/ ma byas pa'i las dang mi 'phrad/ byas pa chud mi 'dza' bar las dang las kyi 'bras bu 'ba' zhig la brten nas ngan song gsum du ltung na ni tsha grang dang*/ bkres skom dang*/ bkol spyod dang glen zhing gti mug ba sogs sdug bsngal bzod blag med pa myong dgos shing*/ chos kyi sgra tsam yang thos par dka'// gnas der skyabs btsal yang mi rnyed// brgya la bde 'gro'i rten thob kyang sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las ma 'das te/ mi rnams la skye rgas na 'chi'i sdug bsngal/ lha ma yin rnams la 'thab cing rtsod pa/ khams 'og ma'i lha rnams la 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal/

khams gong ma'i lha rnams la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal te/ mdor na gnas rigs drug tu rten khams gsum gang du skyes kyang las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du song ste rang dbang med par 'khyams shing sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig (221)gis mnar/ rang nyid sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang sdug bsngal gyis mnar/ sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can thams cad rang gi drin can gyi ma sha stag yin cing*/ ma byas pa la'ang grangs kyis mi chod/ nam byas res kyis tshe 'di'i mas ji ltar drin gyis bskyangs pa ltar drin gyis bskyangs pas drin shin tu che/ drin can gyi ma 'di rnams bde ba 'dod kyang blang dor go log tu spyad pas sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig myong ba las bde ba'i skabs skad cig kyang mi 'dug pas snying re rje/ de bas na ma 'di rnams bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan na ci ma rung*/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral na ci ma rung snyam du byams snying rje shugs drag tu bsgom/ 'o na sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i khur de su la bab na nged rang la babs shing nges par spro na'ang*/ da lta rang nyid la de'i nus pa med/ rang las lhag pa'i tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs 'jig rten gyi chen po rnams la'ang med/ su la yod na bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum kho na la mnga' bas na/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po cher skyabs dang ra mda' zhu bar bgyi'o snyam du 'dun pa snying nas bskyed/ spro na tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams kyi don yid la dran bzhin pas kyang rang rgyud la bskul ma gdab par bya ste// dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'// skyes bu'i don grub thob par gyur pa la// gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na// phyis 'di yang dag 'byor par ga la 'gyur// srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra// 'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la lta dang mtshungs// (222)'gro ba'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste// ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du myur mgyogs 'gro// dus kyis bsnyen nas rgyal po 'gro 'gyur la// longs spyod mdza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brangs// skyes gu dag ni gar gnas gar 'gro yang*// las ni lus dang grib ma bzhin tu 'brangs// sred srid ma rig dbang gis skye bo rnams// mi dang lha dang ngan song rnam gsum po// 'gro ba lnga po dag tu mi mkhas 'khor// dper na rdza mkhan 'khor lo 'khor ba bzhin// srid gsum rga dang nad kyi sdug bsngal 'bar// 'di na 'chi me rab 'bar mgon med de// srid las byung la 'gro ba rtag tu rmongs// bum par chud pa'i bung ba 'khor ba bzhin// de lta'i 'jigs rung srid pa'i sdug bsngal las// mar gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog rnam gsum la// mi phyed dad pas skyabs su bzung bar bgyi// zhes tshig dal bus brjod cing don yid la bsam/

de nas sa phyogs thams cad dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can gyi bkod pa lta bur gyur pa'i rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar yid 'phrog pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'khrigs pa'i dbus su/ seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i steng du pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i mtha' bskor du brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ lung rtogs kyi chos dkon mchog mtshon pa'i glegs bam gyi tshogs/ rang las bslab pa rgan pa man gyi 'phags pa dang so so skye bo'i dge 'dun bstan srung ye shes pa rnams dang bcas pa sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa ltar rang nyid la dgyes shing 'dzum pas zhal phyogs te mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ rang dang sems can (223)thams cad sa gzhi'i ngos su sa chen po'i dreg pa ltar smug shig ge tshogs pas sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig pa'i tshul gyis 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang bla ma dang dkon mchog khyed rnams ma gtogs re sa dang ltos sa gzhan na med pas ci mdzad khyed mkhyen no snyam pa'i mos gus gdung shugs drag pos skyabs su 'gro bar gyur par bsam la/ skyabs 'gro'i tshig ji ltar rigs pa'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig jo bo rje'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga las 'byung ba 'di ltar brjod pa phyag bzhes su mdzad pas/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu brjod par bsam la ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// chos rnams kyi mchog zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun chen po rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes gang mang dang*/

bdag gzhan gyis dus gsum du bsags dang bsag par 'gyur ba'i sbyin tshul sgom pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa bas sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par shog cig snyam pa smon sems dang*/ de'i ched du theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rtsa ba byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas blo sbyong gi gdams pa zab mo nyams su blangs la nyams su myong nges pa zhig ci nas bgyi'o snyam pa 'jug pa sems (224)bskyed pa'i don yid la dran bzhin tu/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam gyi sems can ma lus pa thams cad kyis skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dag tu sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang sgom pa'i rang bzhin can gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ci bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis dang po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o// sems can ma bsgral ba rnams sgrol bar bgyi'o// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o// dbugs ma byung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o// zhes sems bskyed kyi cho ga las byung ba'i tshig 'di lan gsum sogs ji ltar rigs pa blo dang 'dres nges su bya/ slar yang skyabs sems sbrags ma'i tshul du// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces lan gang mang brjod/ bsdu na sangs rgyas chos tshogs kho nas kyang rung*/ de nas mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan/ (225)sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung dang bral/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*/ bde sdug gi rgyu rang phyogs la chags pa/ gzhan phyogs la sdang ba/ de gnyis kyi rgyu las 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa dang bral nas btang snyoms chen po la gnas pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i 'dun pa/ de ltar gyur cig snyam pa'i smon lam/ de ltar bdag gis bgyi'o snyam pa'i dam bca'/ de ltar 'gyur bar bla ma dang dkon mchog mkhyen snyam pa'i gsol 'debs dang 'brel ba'i don yid la dran bzhin tu/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig /ces brjod/ de ltar skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa la brten nas/ skyabs yul rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi sna lnga 'od zer gyi rgyun dang bcas pa byung*/ rang dang sems can thams cad kyi lus sems la zhugs pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib spyi dang*/ khyad par skyabs yul rnams la ma gus pa dang*/ brnyas pa la sogs pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad sbyang*/ lus dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin tu gyur/ tshe dang bsod nams dang lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas/ khyad par bla ma dang dkon mchog gi skyabs 'og tu chud cing thugs rje dang byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs pa la brten nas smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi sems dang*/

tshad med pa bzhi bcos ma ma (226)yin pa rgyud la skyes par mos te sems bzung la mnyam par bzhag mthar skyabs yul rnams mi dmigs par bsam mo// bzhi pa ni/ thog mar gnas khang dang mchod pa'i yo byad la dmigs te/ sman bla dang gnas brtan gyi cho ga sogs las 'byung ba ltar byin rlabs bzhi skor rgyas par bya ba'am/ de tsam mi nus na/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis deng 'dir khor yug gi sa gzhi 'di dag bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar gyur ba'i gzhir/ gzhal med khang rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa legs pas mdzes shing lhun stug pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i khri seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan/ mtha' skor kun tu seng khri pad zla'i gdan grangs med pa dang*/ phyi nang kun tu'ang cha rigs dang 'tshams par lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa zhal zas dang*/ na bza' dang*/ rol mo la sogs pa phul du phyin pa sna tshogs pa phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang*/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis rgyas par gang zhing rgyan bklubs pa dang ldan pa 'byung bar gyur cig /ces dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ badzra sā ra pra mardha ne/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha to/ samya ksaṃ buddhāya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre/ ma hā badzre/ ma hā te dzo badzre/ ma hā bi dyā badzre/ ma hā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bo dhi tsitta maṇḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badzre (227)sarba karma ā we ra ṇa bi sho dha na badzre swā hā/

zhes mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum dang*/ slar yang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de bzhin du gyur cig ces bden pa'i stobs brjod/ de nas 'dun pa rtse gcig pas spos btul zhing snyan pa'i gdangs dang bcas pas// phyogs dus kun nas skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas// nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs te// dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis// 'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol// rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje tshad med 'gro la phyogs bcur gzigs// rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las rgyas mdzad pa// dus gsum bla ma 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs shig /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs bdag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas rang la chos 'di (228)dngos su ston pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i ston pa shākya'i rgyal po la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan rang gi dge 'dun chos skyong srung ma ye shes pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas bskor ba sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs pa ltar byon nas so so'i gdan la dgyes bzhin tu bzhugs par bsams la// bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// ces byon legs bya/

de nas khrus gsol ba'i thog mar snyan brnan pa ni/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// khrus gsol ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mchog la// nyon mongs sgrib pa mi mnga' yang*// sems can sgo gsum sgrib sbyang phyir// gtsang ma'i chab kyis khrus gsol lo// sku phyi ba ni/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// de nas gos 'bul ba ni// de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// (229)na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyong phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /dri med mtshan la sgrib bsal mi mnga' yang*// dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis// nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /bzhugs su gsol ba ni// bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// zhes brjod pas tshogs kyi zhing du brtan par bzhugs par mos la/

gsal snang la sems bzung zhing dad mos shugs drag tu bya'o// lnga pa ni/ lam rgyud la skye ba'i mthun rkyen tshogs bsags pa dang*/ 'gal rkyen sgrib pa sbyong ba'i lhan cig byed rkyen med na/ nyer len gyi rgyu dmigs rnam skyong ba tsam la 'bad kyang lam shin tu skye bar dka' bas bsags sbyong gi gnad rnams bsdus pa'i yan lag bdun pas rgyud sbyong dgos par gsungs pas na/ rgyas par na bzang spyod dang*/ spyod 'jug sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa spel zhing*/ bshags pa'i skabs ltung bshags dang*/ spyi bshags sogs chos spyod rnams las 'byung ba ltar bya ba'am/ bsdu na/ ji snyed su dag sogs nas/ phyir bsngo'o zhes pa'i bar bzang spyod las 'byung (230)ba'i yan lag bdun pa tshig don yid la dran bzhin tu tshar ji ltar rigs pa phyag dang bcas te bya'o// drug pa ni/ maṇḍal gyi gzhi dang*/ tshom bu dgod pa'i 'bru/ dri bzang gi chu sogs sta gon byas la/ thog mar maṇḍal legs par phyi zhing dri bzang gi chus brlan/ de nas lus kyi las su tshom bu dgod pa/ ngag gi las su tshig brjod pa/ yid kyi las su dmigs rnam yid la bya ste/ sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig pas maṇḍal tshom bu so bdun ma'am/ nyer gsum ma/ bdun ma sogs ci rigs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid ces pa'i bar spyi ltar la bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don tu bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pa tsam mam/ spro na/ bzhes nas bdag gi rgyud kyi theg pa chen po'i lam bsgrub pa dang 'gal ba'i phyin ci log gi blo sna mtha' dag myur du 'gags par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis sogs rtogs pa'i yon tan khyad par can myur du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

ces don chen po gsum gyi sgo nas gsol ba gdab/ de nas slar yang mos gus gdung shugs drag tu bskyed la lam 'di'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa ni// tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs 'dren mchog shākyā tog /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rgyal sras mi pham mgon// sa gsum mnga' bdag 'phags pa thogs med zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// kun mkhyen gnyis pa rgyal sras dbyig gi gnyen// mtha' bral don gzigs 'phags pa rnam grol sde// bden gnyis (231)don rtogs btsun pa rnam grol ste/ gsol ba 'debs so= /'gro ba'i rtsa lag gu ṇa mi tra'i zhabs// lta ngan ri dwags 'joms mdzad seng ge bzang*// bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis spel mdzad gang ba spel// gsol ba 'debs so= /yon tan rin chen gter gyur ku sā li// bdag gzhan brje mdzad ku sā li gnyis pa// mkhas grub chen po mnyam med gser gling pa// gsol ba 'debs so= /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i thugs mnga' mar me mdzad// rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ston pa rin po che// bstan pa rin chen gsal mdzad pu to ba// gsol ba 'debs so= /yon tan mchog gis grags pa'i sha ra ba// byang chub thugs gnyis 'byongs pa'i 'chad ka ba// lta spyod rnam par dag pa'i rgyal ba se// gsol ba 'debs so= /gcig tu gzhan don mdzad pa'i skyes mchog lha// bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i lha sdings pa// sgo gsum gzhan don mdzad pa'i lha sdings dbon// gsol ba 'debs so= /dus gsum rgyal ba'i lam gnas yon tan dpal// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas mdzad bde ba dpal// mkhas bcun 'gran zla bral ba'i ka bzhi pa// gsol ba 'debs so= /phan bde kun gyi 'byung gnas rin po che// bsod nams ye shes stobs kyis stong gsum grags// byams dang snying rje'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje// gsol ba 'debs so= /kha skong ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras mchog bzang po dpal// rtse gcig sgrub la brtson mdzad buddha shrī// byang phyogs thub pa'i rgyal tshab e waṃ pa// gsol ba 'debs so=

/phyag na padmo'i rnam 'phrul mus chen rje// rgya chen shes bya kun gzigs gung ru pa// ngag gi dbang phyug gnyug la (232)paṇa chen zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so= /spyan snga sems dpa' chen po chos grags mtshan// chos kyi spyan ldan she'u lo tsā ba// srid zhi'i phun tshogs rab rgyas bco brgyad par// gsol ba 'debs so= /zab rgyas gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin mkhyen rab zhabs// mdo sngags bstan pa'i sgron me rmor chen rje// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid gnas gsar ba// gsol ba 'debs so= /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon sa skya pa// rig pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' mkhas grub dbang*// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so= /yang na/ spyan snga sems dpa' chen po chos grags mtshan// ces pa'i mtshams/ mdo rgyud mnga' bdag gzhon nu chos dpal bzang*// 'jam dbyangs mkhon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub la// gsol ba 'debs so= /mkhas grub dpal 'byor phrin las rab rgyas dang*// phyag na padmo blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde// lung rtogs gter chen blo bzang dar rgyas zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so= /gnas brtan chen po 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i dpal// lam bzang gsal mdzad dge legs rgya mtsho'i zhabs// ngag gi dbang phyug byams mgon gnyis pa la// gsol ba 'debs so= /rig grol mthar phyin ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal// 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bstan pa'i sgron me che// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// zhes so// rnyed dka' yon tan ldan pa'i dal 'byor 'di// don med tshe 'di'i bya bas mi g.yeng bar// drag la rgyun mi 'chad pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' bar byin gyis rlobs// chu bur (233)lta bur mi rtag lus srog 'di// nam 'jig nges pa med par rtogs gyur nas// tshe 'di'i phun tshogs sgrub pa'i bsam sbyor rnams// skad cig tsam yang med par byin gyis rlobs// srid pa'i bde la nam yang ma zhen cing*// rang nyid zhi ba don du mi gnyer bar// 'gro kun don du sangs rgyas sgrub pa yi// bsam sbyor rgyun mi 'chad par byin gyis rlobs// thog med dus nas gnyen gyur 'gro ba rnams// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba mthong gyur na// bu sdug chu yis khyer ba'i ma bzhin tu// bcos min snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs// rang bde 'dod las nyes pa kun 'byung zhing*// gzhan phan sems las yon tan kun 'byung phyir// gzhan skyon bdag la len cing bdag nyid kyi// bde dge gzhan la gtong bar byin gyis rlobs// rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i dgra bo 'dis// thog med dus nas rang gzhan sdug bsngal byas// phyin chad byang chub sems gnyis stobs rgyas nas// bdag 'dzin rtsad nas thon par byin gyis rlobs// 'gro 'dis thog med dus nas phan btags shing*// byang chub sgrub pa'ang 'di la rag las pas// rgyal ba bzhin tu phan bde'i rgyur mthong nas// gus pas spyi bor len par byin gyis rlobs// las ngan dbang gis snod bcud 'gal rkyen gyis// gang ba'i dus 'dir 'gal rkyen kun spangs nas// log nas dam chos sgrub dbang mi gda' bas// rkyen ngan lam du slong bar byin gyis rlobs// bde sdug phan gnod 'byor rgud ci byung yang*// rmi lam yul gyi 'byor rgu ji bzhin du// snang yang bden pa med par shes byas nas// zhen med rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes rgyal sras rin po che thogs med bzang po dpal gyi gsung (234)zhal skong dang bcas pa'i sgo nas gsol ba gdab/

de la spyir don chen po gsum gyi sgo nas gsol ba gdab tshul gong ltar la/ bye brag dal 'byor rnyed dka' kho na bsgom pa'i dbang du byas na maṇḍal gyi gsol 'debs dang*/ skabs 'dir yang*/ bdag gi rgyud la dal 'byor rnyed dka'i rtogs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyin ci log gi blo sna mtha' dag myur du 'gags par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'i rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes ngag tu brjod pa'am yid kyis bsams te dmigs phug pa'i gsol 'debs blo sna 'gyur nges pa bya// mthar tshogs zhing rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi sna lnga 'od zer gyi rgyun dang bcas pa byung*/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus sems la zhugs pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib spyi dang*/ khyad par dngos gzhi'i lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can skye ba la gegs byed kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyang*/ lus dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur// tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas/ khyad par du yang dngos gzhi'i lam gyi rtogs pa rtsol ba med pa rang ngar ma shugs kyis skye ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs shing byin gyis brlab par bsam mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdun/ sngon 'gro rten gyi chos bstan pa/ dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyang ba/ rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba/ tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bstan pa/ blo 'byongs pa'i tshad/ blo sbyong gi dam tshig /blo sbyong gi bslab bya'o// de las sa bcad dang po gnyis ni dmigs thun du bcad (235)nas myong ba mthar ma skyol gyi bar du bskyang bar bya ba yin la/ lhag ma rnams de dag gi gegs sel dang*/ bogs 'don dang*/ bslab bya'i tshul du sbyar bas don grub kyang*/

las dang po pas dmigs thun ci rigs par bskyangs nas goms 'dris brtan pos nam dgos pa'i dus lag tu lon nges pa zhig ci nas gal che ba yin// gang ltar yang dang po sngon 'gro rten gyi chos bstan pa la gsum/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa/ las rgyu 'bras dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa'o// de'i dang po nyams su len pa la mtshon na shes pa rnal du phabs nas/ dal 'byor rang gi ngo bo ngos bzung ste/ de nyid rgyu dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ grangs dang*/ dpe'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba'i tshul dang*/ rnyed na phan yon che ba'i tshul rnams/ rgyal sras rin po che'i gsung sgros 'gro mgon dpal ldan ye shes kyis bsgrigs pa'i blo sbyong snyan brgyud chen mo nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin sgo du ma nas legs par bsams te/ rten khyad par can 'di lta bu rnyed pa'i skabs su tshe rabs gtan gyi 'dun ma dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa dang*/ de las kyang da res skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi snying po byang chub sems gnyis la blo sbyong ba'i gdams pa zab mo 'di nyams su blangs la nyams su myong nges pa zhig ci nas kyang bya'o snyam du shal babs/ rus la thug pa'i tshul du bsgom zhing sems bzung*/ de ltar 'gyur bar bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che mkhyen snyam pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ skabs su bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong gi dmigs pa'ang bya/ des mtshon te sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa 'og ma rnams la'ang dpyad 'jog spel ma'i tshul gyis nyams su blang tshul 'di (236)nyid kyis rigs 'gre ste shes par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ thun de las ldang bar brtsam pa na/ spro zhing nus na slar yang yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal dang bcas pa phul zhing gsol ba shugs drag tu gdab/ gang ltar yang tshogs zhing rnams rten yod na rten dang dbyer med du bzhugs par bsam/ yang na rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs pa'am mi dmigs par bsam pas kyang rung*/

thun gcig tu nyams len byas pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa bas mtshon dus gsum du bsags dang bsag par 'gyur ba'i dge tshogs thams cad rang gzhan sems can thams cad rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu kho nar bsngo zhing*/ de ltar bsngos pa la brten nas dal 'byor rnyed par dka' bas mtshon dngos gzhi'i nyams len gyis sna drangs te sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis bcos ma ma yin par skyes pa'i mthus rang gzhan thams cad gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan pa dang bde ba'i don thams cad yid bzhin tu 'grub par shog cig snyam du/ bzang po spyod pa la sogs pa'i smon lam rgyas pa'am/ de tsam mi nus na// 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang*// kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*// dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo// dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis// bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang*// bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi// zhes bsngo ba dang*// dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*// bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i// dam pa gnyis sku (237)thob par shog /byang chub sems ni rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*// byang chub spyod la gzhol ba dang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung zhing*// bdud kyi las rnams spongs par shog /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni// 'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa// sems can rnams la de 'byor shog /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stongs par shog

/byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar bzhugs pa// de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub par shog /ces smon lam khyad par ba gdab cing*// spro na lam gyi rim pa dang mthun pa'i smon lam 'di ltar yang bya ste// phyogs bcu dus gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs// ye shes thugs rje'i spyan gyis legs gzigs nas// bdag gis smon pa'i gnas 'di myur 'grub mdzod// deng 'dir rtse gcig bsgoms pa'i bsod nams dang*// dus gsum bsags pa'i legs byas mtha' dag kun// sras bcas rgyal ba'i yongs bsngo ji bzhin tu// dmigs med byang chub snying por bsngo bar bgyi// dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan yid can kun// tshe rabs kun tu rgyal bas bsngags pa yi// 'khor lo bzhi dang ldan pa'i lus thob nas// theg chen rigs kyi nus pa rdzogs par shog /dpe grangs rgyu dang ngo bos rnyed bka' ba'i// dal 'byor rten la snying po len pa'i blos// tshul gnas thos bsam sgom (238)pa'i bya ba la// g.yel ba med par rtag tu brtson par shog /dal 'byor rnyed kyang nges par 'chi ba dang*// nam 'chi nges med dam chos kho na las// phan pa med pa'i ngang tshul legs rtogs nas// snying nas 'chi chos myur du sgrub par shog /shi ba'i 'og tu las kyi rjes 'brangs nas// khams gsum rigs drug mtho dman gar skyes kyang*// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba mthong gyur te// nges 'byung drag po gting nas skye bar shog /rang nyid ji ltar 'khor bar sdug bsngal bzhin// ma gyur 'gro kun de las ma 'das pas// bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs bzung ste// skyes bu chen po'i lam la 'jug par shog /shin tu dben zhing nyams dga'i sman ljongs su// nyes pa lnga spong 'du byed brgyad bsten pas// sems byung rnyog pa nye bar zhi ba'i gnas// shin sbyang mi g.yo'i ting 'dzin 'grub par shog

/gzung ba'i chos kun rmi lam lta bu ste// 'dzin pa'i sems nyid ma skyes rig pa'i gshis// dpyod byid gnyen po nyid kyang rang grol ba'i// lhag mthong shes rab phar phyin rtogs par shog /lam gyi ngo bo kun gzhi 'od gsal dbyings// zhi lhag zung 'jug ngang du mnyam bzhag cing*// thun mtshams rten 'byung sgyu ma'i skyes bu yis// rnam dkar dge tshogs rgya chen sdud par shog /mkha' khyab 'gro kun mar shes drin dran cing*// drin bzo'i slad du yid 'ong byams pa dang*// snying rje chen po'i sbyor ba la brten nas// rmad byung lhag bsam rgyud la skye bar shog /khyad par bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs kun// phongs pa med par gzhan la gtong ba dang*// gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun 'byung rgyu dang bcas// snying nas rang gi khur du len par shog /rlung dang sbyar nas dmigs pa'i rtsal sbyong zhing*// (239)nye mkhon bar ma'i yul las dug gsum gyis// gdung bas mnar ba'i yid can ji snyed kyang*// rlabs chen dge rtsa gsum la 'god par shog /'gro 'chag nyal 'dug spyod lam thams cad du// dran dang shes bzhin gnyen po legs brten nas// smon pa'i tshig dang rjes su mthun pa yi// byang chub sems mchog rtag tu sbyong bar shog /snod bcud sdig pa'i 'bras bus gang ba'i tshe// sdug bsngal rtsa ba bdag 'dzin 'dul ba dang*// byang chub sgrub pa gang la rag las phyir// 'gro kun bka' drin snying nas bsgom par shog /'khrul snang skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba'i// sku bzhi dbyer med chen por ngo 'phrod nas// rtse gcig bsgom pa'i stong nyid srung ba yis// gzung 'dzin spros mtshan dbyings su zhi bar shog /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyang gdon la mchod pa dang*// chos skyong tshogs la gtor ma 'bul ba ste// sbyor ba bzhi sogs thabs mkhas dpag med kyis// rkyen ngan byang chub lam du bsgyur bar shog

/'phen pas gzhi bzung goms pa'i stobs rdzogs shing*// bsags sbyang la brtson smon lam mthar son pas// 'di dang 'chi kha bar do'i gnas skabs kun// stobs lnga'i nyams len snying por dril bar shog /legs gsungs chos kun dgongs pa gcig 'dus pa'i// nyams myong rang sems dpang por thub pa dang*// chos dang sems 'dres yid bde 'ba' zhig ngang*// mnyam rjes kun tu lam khyer brtan par shog /bslab gsum rnam dag tho co'i spyod pa spang*// phyogs dang ris med byang chub sems mchog 'byongs// bsam sbyor bag yod spyod pas dus 'da' ba'i// blo sbyong dam tshig srog bzhin srung bar shog /rtag tu gzhan phan bsam pa 'ba' zhig gis// 'byor (240)rgud bde sdug mtho dman ci byung yang*// rgyal ba'i sras kyi bslab par bya ba dang*// nam yang mi 'bral grogs su 'gyur bar shog /mdor na 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// theg mchog dge ba'i bshes dang mi 'bral zhing*// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang 'dir bsten na// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol// ces pa'i tshig don yid la dran bzhin tu 'dun pa rtse gcig pas spyod lam la 'jug go /gnyis pa thun mtshams su ji ltar bya ba ni// thun gyi dngos gzhi'i skabs su gang bsgoms pa'i nyams len gyi rtsi dang ma bral bar dran pa dang*// shes bzhin dang*/ bag yod pas kun nas bslangs te spyod lam thams cad mi dge ba dang*// lung ma bstan gyi dbang du ma song bar// dge ba'i rtsa ba 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar bya ba ste/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsgom pa'i skabs la mtshon na/ de nyid ston pa'i mdo dang bstan bcos rnams la yang dang yang du blta zhing tshig tu'ang brjod la nges shes bskyed/ da res rten bzang po 'di lta bu thob ba'i skabs su don med du ma song bar bsam pa dang sbyor ba gnyis ka'i sgo nas snying po len pa'i thabs la 'bad par bgyi'o snyam du yid la bsam/

ngag tu brjod/ lag len la thebs par bya bas mtshon te shes par bya'o// myong ba cung zad skyes pas stan thog gcig tu lam cha tshang bar bsgom par 'dod na/ sbyor ba'i chos drug tshul bzhin tu byas pas kun slong bcos pa'i nang du sngon 'gro'i chos rnams 'du bas na/ dngos gzhi zhi lhag zung 'jug gi nyams len la ji tsam gnas kyi bar du blo 'jog /de la mi gnas na gnas lugs ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la dmigs pa med pa'i byams pa dang snying rje sgyu ma lta bu bsgom/ bde sdug gtong len gyi dmigs pa kho na la (241)gnad du bsnun/ thun las ldang bar phyogs pa na/ rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba man chad kyi sa bcad rnams la'ang bshar bsgom gyi tshul rgyas bsdus gang rung re byas la bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug go /de'ang las dang po pas bsags sbyong kho na gal che bas na skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ yan lag bdun pa spyi dang khyad par ltung bshags sogs dang sbrags te phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ maṇḍal 'bul ba rnams 'bum ther re'am rtags ma byung gi bar nan tan du bya/ de nas sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa rnams so so'i myong ba ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom mo// 'di ni gtso bor blo sbyong snyan brgyud chen mo dang bstun pa yin kyang*/ sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog gis mdzad pa'i legs bshad kun 'dus la'ang sbyar bar spro na/ sbyor ba'i chos bzhi pa tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa'i skabs gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlabs rjes khrid yig gi gzhung dang ngag 'don gzhan nas 'byung ba sogs gang rung ltar blo sbyong bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsal gdab yan lag bdun pa dang maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab pa rnams 'dra/ rjes su thun bsdu ba'i tshe bla ma rang gi snying dbus su spyan drangs pa'i tshul gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar nyams su blangs rjes bsngo smon sogs dkyus bzhin byas pas don 'grub la/

sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'i skabs kyi dmigs pa'i spros pa cung zad ma 'dra ba rnams kyang gzhung bzhin du shes par byas la nyams su blang ngo*// mtha' yas 'gro la phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi// rin chen byang chub sems kyi sa bon mchog /blo sbyong bdud rtsis bran pa'i dge mtshan gyis// rnam mkhyen 'bras bzang myur du smin par shog /ces pa'ang theg pa chen (242)po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa phan bde bzang pos bka' stsal rin po che'i phreng bas bskul ba don yod par bya ba'i phyir/ rje bla ma dam pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag rig pa'i ma hā paṇḍi ta dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas dpal bzang po sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhin tu spyod pa rnams las tshul 'di'i bka' drin mang du thob pa'i rgyal khams kyi bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos/ rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgros dang phyag bzhes ltar nyung gsal snying por dril te sbyar ba dge legs mchog tu gyur cig /sarba dā ka lyā ṇaṃ bha ba tu//
